value_unit: all 15 raw donor archives re-audited at archive/file/directory/definition/semantic levels
decision_rationale: The second-order pass rechecks the exact 949 predecessor decisions against unchanged donor bytes and separately records refined value units instead of inflating donor counts.
invariant: all 1,349 donor files and 16,310 definitions remain attributable while every predecessor semantic row receives an explicit 228 review status
negative_invariant: large row counts alone cannot substitute for semantic review

decision_rationale: The donor dependency exposes passphrase-aware parsing; LumiNet now admits encrypted private keys without weakening its existing pinned host-key model.
invariant: passphrase is accepted only with a private key and at least one valid auth method must exist before network I/O
negative_invariant: orphan passphrases and invalid private-key-only auth cannot reach the network
migration_impact: additive optional credential field; password fallback preserved

value_unit: SSH key-passphrase secret redaction across evasion contract
decision_rationale: The new passphrase remains secret-bearing runtime state and is redacted/restored through the existing evasion contract sentinel rather than exposed as ordinary configuration.
invariant: private-key passphrase never appears in redacted operator/evidence payloads
negative_invariant: secret-bearing passphrases cannot cross the redacted contract or become an orphan credential

decision_rationale: The converter corpus exposes independently useful rule types and trailing no-resolve semantics; LumiNet absorbs them into its offline local planner without remote fetching or installation.
invariant: rule parsing is bounded, deterministic, duplicate-aware, and local-only
negative_invariant: unknown executable syntax, invalid ports/CIDRs, remote rule-set URLs, and implicit fetch/install fail closed

decision_rationale: Select, url-test, fallback, and load-balance semantics become a read-only policy-group preview. Active url-test network probes are intentionally replaced by caller-supplied latency evidence.
invariant: automatic selection excludes unhealthy candidates and all limits/latency/weights are bounded
negative_invariant: planner performs no probe, installs no policy, and cannot dispatch an unhealthy candidate automatically

value_unit: group preset structure without mutable remote corpus adoption
decision_rationale: Preset composition and group naming are useful design evidence, but the bundled domain/provider corpus is mutable/stale external policy and is not silently embedded as target truth.
invariant: preset modes are enumerated separately from mutable remote rule data
negative_invariant: donor rule corpus never becomes authoritative target policy merely because it is large

value_unit: browser family/extension identity/native host manifest contract
decision_rationale: Chrome/Firefox native-messaging identity constraints and host allowlists are captured as a bounded manifest plan without registering a host.
invariant: browser identity, allowed origins/extensions, commands, permissions, and 1 MiB message limit are explicit
negative_invariant: planner cannot register a native host or grant wildcard browser authority

value_unit: native-message reconnect/backoff and loopback proxy bypass contract
decision_rationale: Reconnect/backoff and loopback bypass behavior are retained as plan data while proxy authority stays in the browser/host owners.
invariant: reconnect backoff is finite and proxy target must be explicit loopback http/socks5 with no credentials/query/fragment
negative_invariant: planner cannot mutate browser proxy state and cannot accept remote proxy targets

decision_rationale: Managed edge tunnel composition becomes a target-native immutable graph preset; secret-bearing deployment/install steps are not imported.
invariant: preset expands to a bounded acyclic service graph with topological start and reverse rollback order
negative_invariant: planner downloads nothing and writes no systemd/cron/runit/Caddy/service configuration

value_unit: reverse TLS and websocket relay topology presets
decision_rationale: Reverse TLS/WS listener and relay roles become explicit service graph presets rather than a root-owned installer/runtime.
invariant: reverse and websocket presets use the same DAG/restart/rollback invariants as explicit graphs
negative_invariant: clone/build/systemd/root file-write behaviors cannot cross the planning boundary

decision_rationale: MWGP index translation reveals that mappings are identity/lifetime state and that live rewrites affect authenticated packet fields. LumiNet records the safe contract without becoming another WireGuard packet mutator.
invariant: indexes are nonzero/unique, peer-bound, expire within 24h, and persisted mappings require post-restart revalidation
negative_invariant: planner rewrites no packets/restores no mappings and translation never substitutes for WireGuard authentication/replay/cookie admission

decision_rationale: The predecessor guardrail is retained after re-reading the full donor: packet obfuscation cannot be treated as authentication, confidentiality, replay protection, or cookie/MAC2 substitution.
invariant: authentication and anti-replay remain WireGuard-owned
negative_invariant: obfuscation cannot grant trust or bypass cryptographic admission

value_unit: SIP003 plugin intent preservation/fail-closed core compatibility
decision_rationale: Parsed Shadowsocks plugin intent was preserved in share links but could be silently dropped by core generation. Supported sing-box internal plugins are now retained; unsupported plugin/prefix intent fails closed, and Xray refuses extensions it cannot represent.
invariant: all parsed plugin/prefix semantics must either reach a compatible core config or fail before process start
negative_invariant: core generation cannot silently erase SIP003 plugin/prefix intent

value_unit: parsed protocol versus executable external-core truth
decision_rationale: SSR remains parse/import compatibility evidence, not an executable maintained-core protocol. LumiNet now exposes that distinction before activation instead of presenting a late-failing action.
invariant: credential-redacted node views expose whether any maintained external-core builder can represent the full config and which cores qualify
negative_invariant: parsed/importable does not imply activatable; unsupported nodes cannot offer an enabled Activate SOCKS action
migration_impact: additive runtime-truth fields and UI state

decision_rationale: The donor explicitly rejects listener/upstream self-loops. LumiNet now checks declared literal endpoints offline, including loopback/unspecified same-port aliases, before treating a gateway plan as ready.
invariant: declared listener/upstream endpoint pairs cannot resolve to a local self-loop
negative_invariant: guard performs no DNS/network I/O and hostname inference cannot fabricate safety

decision_rationale: The donor contains a macOS BPF backend, but the target live raw injector still selects the unsupported stub on macOS and this environment cannot establish native parity. The gap stays explicit rather than being claimed by source inspection.
invariant: unsupported platforms remain visibly unsupported until native build/runtime evidence exists
negative_invariant: donor source cannot grant a target platform-support claim

decision_rationale: Worker protocol evidence becomes explicit planning invariants: one correlated request per NDJSON line, ready handshake before dispatch, bounded frame/readiness limits, and recycle on desynchronization.
invariant: protocol framing, request correlation, frame cap, ready timeout, and recycle behavior are explicit and bounded
negative_invariant: planner starts no worker and protocol desynchronization cannot be ignored

value_unit: depth-one affinity buffering and unbuffered spillover/backpressure
decision_rationale: The donor distinguishes one queued affinity job from unbuffered shared spillover. LumiNet records those queue semantics explicitly instead of implying generic buffering.
invariant: affinity queue depth is one, shared spillover depth is zero, deterministic preference spills only to healthy capacity
negative_invariant: planner cannot create an unbounded queue or assign unhealthy/saturated workers

decision_rationale: A cancelled caller may fail open while a bounded worker call continues to warm; protocol errors recycle the worker and cold-first-call behavior is telemetry-visible. These remain planning semantics, not process authority.
invariant: caller cancellation, warming, recycle, deadlines, and restart backoff remain bounded and explicit
negative_invariant: planner cannot spawn/restart a process or turn cancellation into unbounded background work

value_unit: Linux socket-to-process attribution via inet_diag + /proc inode ownership
decision_rationale: The donor demonstrates a real Linux process-attribution mechanism while LumiCore currently returns an empty connection-owner list off Windows. Cargo/rustc are unavailable in this environment, so 228 records the gap rather than shipping an uncompiled native-path change.
invariant: platform support claims require compiled/native runtime evidence
negative_invariant: source similarity cannot justify a Linux process-attribution support claim

decision_rationale: The eBPF plane requires kernel hooks, cgroup lifecycle, maps, binary build/provisioning, and route ownership. Existing LumiNet platform/routing owners remain authoritative; 228 does not introduce a second kernel bypass plane.
invariant: kernel/process routing has one target owner and requires explicit platform validation
negative_invariant: peer eBPF hooks cannot silently attach or bypass routing authority

decision_rationale: SRSC conditional cache semantics were rechecked against LumiNet subscription source health and ETag revalidation; the target already owns the stronger bounded refresh/retry/provenance path.
invariant: conditional refresh/retry state remains profile-service-owned
negative_invariant: a second cache/resource fetch authority cannot bypass subscription source health or retry policy

decision_rationale: The existing 226 tailnet transaction planner remains the correct target-native absorption; 228 found no missing authority-safe primitive requiring a second client or credential path.
invariant: mutating operations remain explicit and credential-free in the planner
negative_invariant: planner makes no Tailnet API request and cannot return generated secret material

decision_rationale: Donor provider lists are operationally useful evidence but age independently of code. LumiNet keeps freshness/provenance and clean-IP discovery in target owners instead of embedding peer lists as timeless truth.
invariant: provider data must expose source/freshness and scan results remain evidence rather than authority
negative_invariant: stale donor IP/proxy lists cannot become routing truth merely through convergence

decision_rationale: The donor corpus was rechecked but not promoted wholesale; scan fan-out and candidate freshness are deliberate target product/resource decisions.
invariant: candidate corpus changes remain bounded and deliberate
negative_invariant: larger peer lists cannot silently increase active scan fan-out

decision_rationale: The peer UI mixes useful workflow context with mutable binary download/install and privileged runtime control. LumiNet keeps read-only/evidence surfaces and target update/runtime owners instead.
invariant: operator UI may plan/observe but cannot become source/install/raw-packet authority
negative_invariant: mutable latest downloads or UI state cannot bypass signed update/runtime authority

value_unit: canonical automatic mutation retry authority and bypass audit
decision_rationale: 228 does not add a second retry engine: the existing config Manager.Mutate remains canonical and is now protected by a dedicated bypass/semantics checker. Remote actions retain their separate idempotent/reconcile/single-attempt safety classes.
invariant: default config retry attempts=3, max=8, only revision conflicts retry from a fresh snapshot; explicit ExpectedRevision is single-attempt CAS
negative_invariant: mutation callbacks cannot perform external side effects and direct persistence/API bypasses cannot create unbounded/unsafe retries
migration_impact: verification/hardening only; no duplicate retry owner
